Global Energy Monitor (2026). Global Gas Infrastructure Tracker: LNG Terminals, October 2026 release. https://globalenergymonitor.org/projects/global-gas-infrastructure-tracker/ (accessed 2026-11-11).

HELD LOCALLY since 2026-11-11 (gem-data.zip). One row per terminal unit (phase or train), import and export. Loaded by gem_extract.py: liquefaction capacity per train of operating export units, split into base-load (0.5 Mt/yr or more per train), small-scale (under 0.5) and floating. Scope rule: Canada where three or more units, else North America, else global (Brad 2026-11-11). Traps: a unit is often a phase of several trains (LNG Canada 'Phase 1 (T1-T2)' 14 Mt/yr, Calcasieu Pass 'T1-T18'), divided by the trains in its name; debottlenecking rows are left out. Costs to _other-values (cost year not stated). Canadian roster in _canada-stock.csv.
